model_annotation: The plot illustrates the performance of various knowledge editing methods on the CliKT dataset across different co-occurrence number groups. The x-axis represents co-occurrence number groups with a logarithmic scale, labeled as $<10^1$, $[10^1,10^2]$, $[10^2,10^3]$, and $\geq10^3$. The y-axis displays accuracy as a percentage with a linear scale, ranging from 55% to 65%, with tick labels at 5% intervals. The plot features five lines, each representing a different method: Base (black, solid, square markers), MEND (red, solid, circle markers), FT (blue, solid, triangle markers), IKE (orange, solid, diamond markers), and ROME (green, solid, star markers). Starting at the lowest point on the x-axis, the Base line begins at approximately 32.52% and increases steadily to around 98.66%. The MEND line starts at about 91.32% and rises to roughly 89.87%. The FT line begins at approximately 33.35% and increases to around 34.84%. The IKE line starts at about 83.87% and rises to roughly 85.91%. The ROME line begins at approximately 98.02% and increases steadily to around 98.63%.
